Financial Statement Analysis

Detect irregularities before they cost you

Built for accountants, CFOs, lenders, and investors

Go beyond the numbers with a full picture

Financial statements hold a lot of information — and a few red flags that are easy to miss. We take your Statement of Financial Position and Income Statement (IFRS or GAAP, up to five years of history) and reclassify them the way analysts actually read them: current vs. non‑current, financial debt isolated from trade liabilities, EBIT and EBITDA broken out clearly.

From there we calculate the ratios that matter across profitability, liquidity, capital structure, and solvency, compare them against industry benchmarks, and flag the deviations worth a second look.

Whether you're an auditor, a lender assessing creditworthiness, or a finance team closing the books, you get a clear, evidence‑backed view of where the risk lives.

How we detect anomalies

Statement extraction

Pull structured data from the balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow statement.

Reclassification

Rebuild the statements the way analysts read them — current/non‑current, financial debt isolated.

Ratio & trend analysis

Calculate 35+ ratios across profitability, liquidity, solvency, and capital structure.

Anomaly detection

Flag unusual entries, outliers, and patterns that don't match the company's own history.

Benchmarking & rating

Compare against industry peers and run recognized bankruptcy‑risk models for a rating score.

Automated reporting

Get a finished report with charts, ratios, and plain‑language commentary, ready to edit.

What's inside the report

Guided data entry

Enter up to five years of balance sheet and income statement data. We flag input errors and suggest corrections as you go.

Full ratio breakdown

Profitability, liquidity, solvency, and capital‑structure ratios, each with a plain‑language explanation of what it means.

Cash flow statement

See where cash was generated or absorbed during the year, plus automatically calculated Free Cash Flow to the Firm and to Equity.

Rating & stress test

A credit‑style rating built on recognized bankruptcy‑risk models, plus a sales‑drop stress test to check debt coverage.

Core capabilities

Balance sheet analysis

Detect anomalies in assets, liabilities, and equity composition.

Income statement review

Flag unusual revenue recognition, expense patterns, and margins.

Cash flow anomalies

Identify gaps between reported earnings and actual cash flow.

Fraud indicators

Surface red flags like revenue manipulation or hidden expenses.

Historical trend analysis

Track performance across up to five years for pattern detection.

Sensitivity & stress testing

Model revenue drops of 5%, 10%, and 30% to test debt coverage.
